---
title: "Distance from shore"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: center

library(leaflet)

sites <- read.csv("~/Documents/ATI_website/Data/sites_metadata.csv")
circles = data.frame(lng = sites$Longitude, lat = sites$Latitude,
                     values = sites$Distance_from_shore)

pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "viridis", domain = circles$values,
                    na.color = "transparent")
metadata = paste0("Site ",sites$Site, "<hr>", "Distance from shore: ", sites$Distance_from_shore)


leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%  # Satellite imagery
  setView(lng = -149.84, lat = -17.5392, zoom = 12) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = circles, color = ~pal(values), 
                   radius = 3, opacity = 1, fillOpacity = 0.8,
                   popup = metadata) %>%
  addLegend(data = circles,
            position = "bottomright",
            pal = pal, values = ~values,
            title = "Legend",
            opacity = 1)

```
